author: culhatsker
title: GGUF frontend test_parser.cpp fails to build under C++20 mode (char8_t/std::string mismatch in unicode path concatenation)
signature: error c2676 binary operator std string does not define operator conversion acceptable predefined operator make_path no matching overloaded function found char8_t const object must be initialized|Code Issue

failed_jobs.name: Build (C++20, non-blocking) / Build
failed_jobs.symptom: Cmake build - OpenVINO step fails compiling src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp with C2676/C2672/C2737/C3536 errors

key_errors:
FAILED: src/frontends/gguf/tests/CMakeFiles/ov_gguf_frontend_tests.dir/Release/test_parser.cpp.obj
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2676: binary '+': 'std::string' does not define this operator or a conversion to a type acceptable to the predefined operator
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2672: 'ov::util::make_path': no matching overloaded function found

C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(731): error C2737: 'unicode_prefix': const object must be initialized
C:\actions-runner\_work\openvino\openvino\openvino\src\frontends\gguf\tests\test_parser.cpp(733): error C3536: 'unicode_prefix': cannot be used before it is initialized
ninja: build stopped: subcommand failed.
root_cause: In test_parser.cpp line 731, the code does `ov::util::make_path(m_base + u8"_模型_żółć")` where `m_base` is `std::string` and the literal is a UTF-8 `char8_t` string literal (`u8"..."`). Under the C++20 standard (this job builds with `-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20`), `u8"..."` literals are typed as `const char8_t[]` instead of `const char[]` (a C++20 language change), so `std::string::operator+` can no longer implicitly convert/concatenate it with `std::string`, causing MSVC error C2676. The resulting compile error leaves `unicode_prefix` uninitialized (C2737/C3536), cascading into a hard build failure that aborts the whole Ninja build. This is unrelated to the PR's actual change (src/plugins/intel_npu/.../CMakeLists.txt) — it is a pre-existing GGUF test source incompatible with C++20 char8_t typing, previously seen on PRs #39524 and #39270.
reproduction_steps: Configure and build OpenVINO with `-DCMAKE_CXX_STANDARD=20 -DENABLE_OV_GGUF_FRONTEND=ON -DENABLE_TESTS=ON` (any platform/compiler enforcing char8_t typing for u8 literals, e.g. MSVC 19.42+ or GCC/Clang with -std=c++20) and build target `ov_gguf_frontend_tests`; the compile of src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp fails at line 731.
recommended_actions: In src/frontends/gguf/tests/test_parser.cpp:731, stop concatenating std::string with a u8 literal directly; instead construct the unicode suffix as a std::u8string (or std::string via explicit (const char*) reinterpret of the u8 literal's data) before calling ov::util::make_path, e.g. `ov::util::make_path(m_base + std::string(reinterpret_cast<const char*>(u8"_模型_żółć")))` or build the path by concatenating std::filesystem::path components instead of raw strings.

Alternatively, change m_base concatenation to use std::filesystem::path throughout (path / path) rather than std::string '+' so char8_t literal handling is delegated to std::filesystem::path's native u8string constructor overload.

Add a dedicated C++20 CI smoke build (or enable a non-blocking cpp20 job for the gguf frontend tests target specifically) to catch this class of char8_t typing issue before merge, since the regular blocking Windows job may use an older C++ standard.
Once fixed, this build is 'non-blocking' per job name, so after the source fix, verify the non-blocking build job also turns green on a subsequent merge-queue run.
prevention_strategies: Avoid raw std::string + u8"..." concatenation in portable C++20 code; always wrap UTF-8 literals via std::u8string or std::filesystem::path construction helpers so compiler char8_t strictness does not break the build. Add a lightweight CI job (or clang-tidy/cpplint rule) that flags `u8"` literal usage concatenated with std::string via operator+.
historical_context: This exact signature (60c87e1ef4d6a044) has been seen 2 times before (2026-11-05T10:50:38Z on run 41997458873 for PR #39270, and 2026-11-05T14:03:59Z on run 42026335242 for PR #39524), always in the 'Build (C++20, non-blocking)' job, and always traced to the same line 731 unicode_prefix construction in test_parser.cpp. This is now the 3rd occurrence, confirming the C++20 GGUF test source bug has not yet been fixed.
